name: ReadOnlyAttribute
src_typeComment: Drop above any [SerializeField] to show it in the Inspector but prevent editing — useful for a "live debug view" field (current state, a computed value) you want visible but not hand-editable. This attribute type must live outside any Editor folder so scripts using it still compile in player builds; the drawer that actually disables the field lives in AttributeDrawers/Editor/ReadOnlyDrawer.cs.
